title: Penny Blue, 500 CFA francs, WORLD’S MOST VALUABLE STAMPS
descriptionPlain: Description Penny Blue is the direct successor to the world’s first stamp. Issued in 1840, it marked a turning point in the history of communication and public postal services. Its distinctive blue color and the portrait of Queen Victoria quickly became enduring icons of philately.
